description: Canonical business schema approved for a local end-to-end Travel storage smoke test. One product record represents one distinct plan or tier and product-type combination.

review.rationale: Approved for a local end-to-end PostgreSQL storage smoke test. Field semantics and storage strategies require further review before production use.

fields.name: product_name
fields.description: Official full plan-level name, unique within the insurer. Include product scope or frequency and plan tier when the published plan name alone is ambiguous; do not include the insurer brand.

fields.name: product_type
fields.description: Primary mutually exclusive travel product classification. Business is represented by customer_segment and cruise by cruise fields rather than by this classifier.

fields.name: plan_name
fields.description: Published plan tier or level, such as Basic, Comprehensive, or Comprehensive+. Use null when the product has no distinct tier name.

fields.name: geographic_scope
fields.description: Normalised broad geographic scope used for filtering; detailed region wording belongs in geographic_coverage_details.

fields.name: trip_frequency
fields.description: Whether the plan covers one continuous journey or multiple journeys during an annual policy period.

fields.name: customer_segment
fields.description: Normalised intended customer segment. Use business only for products specifically designed for business travel.

fields.name: cruise_cover_available
fields.description: Whether cruise cover is included or can be selected for the plan. Detailed requirements and conditions belong in cruise_cover_rules.

fields.name: max_trip_duration_days
fields.description: Maximum duration in days for each journey, especially for annual multi-trip products. Use null when not stated or not applicable.

fields.name: overall_policy_duration_days
fields.description: Maximum overall policy period in days when explicitly stated. Use null rather than converting an imprecise duration.

fields.name: age_eligibility_min
fields.description: Minimum eligible traveller age in years when the PDS states a plan-level minimum. Benefit-specific age rules belong in benefits.

fields.name: age_eligibility_max
fields.description: Maximum eligible traveller age in years when the PDS states a plan-level maximum. Benefit-specific age rules belong in benefits.

fields.name: rental_vehicle_excess_limit_aud
fields.description: Headline maximum rental-vehicle insurance excess benefit in Australian dollars when explicitly stated for the plan. Detailed conditions and other currencies belong in benefits.

fields.name: personal_liability_limit_aud
fields.description: Headline personal-liability benefit limit in Australian dollars when explicitly stated for the plan. The applicable basis and conditions belong in benefits.

fields.name: baggage_overall_limit_aud
fields.description: Headline overall baggage and personal-effects limit in Australian dollars when explicitly stated for the plan. Item sublimits and conditions belong in benefits.

fields.name: geographic_coverage_details
fields.description: Detailed PDS wording for covered countries, regions, destination-selection rules, exclusions, and other geographic conditions.

fields.name: residency_eligibility
fields.description: Residency, Medicare, visa, departure-location, and return-location requirements for eligibility.

fields.name: dependent_children_policy
fields.description: Rules for dependent children, including age thresholds, inclusion in the premium, and travel-with-adult requirements.

fields.name: pre_existing_medical_conditions_policy
fields.description: Rules for pre-existing medical conditions, including automatic inclusions, assessment, exclusions, additional premiums, excesses, and approval requirements.

fields.name: pregnancy_cover
fields.description: Pregnancy coverage, gestational limits, covered complications, exclusions, and any medical-assessment requirements.

fields.name: excess_options
fields.description: Available policy excess choices. Preserve amount, currency, application basis, affected plan or benefit, and notes for each option.

fields.name: special_excesses
fields.description: Additional event-specific excesses. Preserve trigger, amount, currency, whether it stacks with the standard excess, and notes.

fields.name: cancellation_cover_selection
fields.description: How cancellation or amendment cover is included or selected, including whether the policyholder chooses a sum insured and any plan-level rules.

fields.name: cruise_cover_rules
fields.description: Detailed cruise-cover inclusions, optional-add-on requirements, cruise types, eligibility conditions, and exclusions.

fields.name: benefits
fields.description: Plan benefits. Preserve a canonical category where available, included status, numeric or text limit, currency and limit basis, sublimits, excess, waiting period, conditions, required add-on, notes, and source evidence. Do not infer an amount or inclusion that the PDS does not state.

fields.name: add_ons_and_options
fields.description: Optional or bundled cover variations. Preserve name, description, availability by plan, additional-premium status, affected benefits, limits, eligibility, conditions, and evidence.

fields.name: notable_exclusions
fields.description: Material plan exclusions and conditions that affect comparison or eligibility. Preserve the PDS meaning without broadening or narrowing it.

fields.name: claims_and_assistance
fields.description: Claims process, emergency-assistance triggers, prior-approval rules, notification requirements, and supporting-document requirements.

fields.name: cooling_off_and_refunds
fields.description: Cooling-off period, cancellation timing, fees, refund eligibility, and no-claim or pre-departure conditions.

fields.name: evidence
fields.description: Source citations for plan-level facts. Preserve source document, page, section, quote or snippet, and the field or claim supported.
